graph.title: Emma's Splash Pool

parts.label: Brick Round 2x2 with axle hole (flower pot)

notes: The three separate groups are not an error. The booklet builds three independent models, and each one starts with its own thumbnail box: the flower pot on page 3, the sun lounger with umbrella and drink on pages 4-8, and the splash pool on pages 9-12. The flower pot is b1-b4, the lounger is b5-b21, and the pool is b22-b39. Page 13 only stands them next to each other, and no piece joins one model to another. I kept them as three groups and added no joins between them. Joining them would invent connections that the manual does not show.
The minifigure (Emma: hair, head, torso, legs) is not in the provided parts list, so it is not modelled. Page 2 builds it, but it is not part of the brick graph.
The pictures are low-resolution, so exact attachment points (which stud of which piece) are inferred. Ports are left null.
The pool step stack is assumed to be b32 on a base plate, b33 on b32, and b34 on b33, with a lime tile on each of the three levels.
Panels and macaroni bricks are assumed to be mounted on the pink base plates. The four macaroni bricks are two in step 3 and two in step 8.
The lounger's 2x6 plate (b7) sits on the 2x4 plate (b6). The two lime round plates (b8, b9) are feet under the 2x6 plate.
The goblet (b17) stands on a stud of the pink brick, and the round 1x1 brick (b15) holds the umbrella bar on another stud. The dish (b20) sits on top of the bar.
